blocks.text: Be productive on the go slip the thin and lightweight Dell Latitude 2-in-1 travel keyboard into your bag and head out to your next meeting or business trip. You'll be able to remain productive on the go with the laptop-like experience of the travel keyboard. Simply snap it onto your tablet when you're ready to work or fold it on top of your tablet to protect the screen from scratches in transit. The microfiber material under the keyboard is stain resistant and non-absorbent, allowing it to be easily cleaned. Hot Keys Function - Search, mute, brightness, play/pause, backward, forward, volume -, volume +.

items: Easily transition from tablet to laptop mode
This product is compatible with the following systems - Latitude 5285 2-in-1, Latitude 5290 2-in-1
